title: U Mass - C-Peptide Assay Protocol
author: Jason Kim
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.xttfnnn
materials: Allow reagents and assay plate to come to room temperature. Gently remove well contents and wash plate 3x following the instructions listed in the Plate Washing section.
Add 50 µL of Detection Antibodies into each well. Allow the Detection Antibodies to warm to room temperature prior to addition.

steps.title: Prepare Plate with Assay Buffer
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL of Assay Buffer into each well of the plate, seal, and mix on a plate shaker for 10 minutes at room temperature (20-25°C).

steps.title: Remove Assay Buffer
steps.instruction: Decant Assay Buffer and remove residual amounts from all wells by inverting the plate and tapping it smartly onto absorbent towels several times.

steps.title: Add Standards, Controls, and Samples
steps.instruction: Add 10 µL of each Standard, Control, or sample into the appropriate wells, using the provided Serum Matrix for serum/plasma samples or proper control culture medium for tissue culture/supernatants.

steps.title: Add Magnetic Beads
steps.instruction: Vortex the Mixing Bottle and add 25 μL of mixed or premixed beads to each well, shaking the bead bottle intermittently during addition to avoid settling.

steps.title: Incubate Beads Overnight
steps.instruction: Seal the plate with a plate sealer, wrap with foil, and incubate with agitation on a plate shaker overnight (18~20 hours) at 4°C.

steps.title: Incubate at Room Temperature
steps.instruction: Seal, cover with foil, and incubate with agitation on a plate shaker for 30 minutes at room temperature (20~25°C). Do not aspirate after this incubation.

steps.title: Add Streptavidin-Phycoerythrin
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL Streptavidin-Phycoerythrin to each well containing the 50 µL of Detection Antibodies.

steps.title: Incubate Streptavidin-Phycoerythrin
steps.instruction: Seal, cover with foil, and incubate with agitation on a plate shaker for 30 minutes at room temperature (20~25°C).

steps.title: Wash Plate
steps.instruction: Gently remove well contents and wash the plate 3x using the magnetic bead washing procedure.

substeps.instruction: Let plate soak on magnet for 60 seconds to allow complete settling of magnetic beads.
Wash plate with 200 µL/well of Wash Buffer.
Allow beads to soak for 60 seconds, then remove Wash Buffer by aspiration after each wash.
If using a Bio-Tek ELx405 plate washer, follow the instructed equipment settings.

steps.title: Resuspend Beads
steps.instruction: Add 150 µL of Sheath Fluid to all wells and resuspend the beads on a plate shaker for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Run Bioplex 200 Analysis
steps.instruction: Run the plate on Bioplex 200, setting parameters for 125 l and 75 beads per bead set.

steps.title: Analyze Data
steps.instruction: Save and analyze the Median Fluorescent Intensity (MFI) data using a 5-parameter logistic or spline curve-fitting method to calculate concentrations. For diluted samples, multiply the calculated concentration by the dilution factor.

description: Add 10 µL of appropriate matrix solution to the background, standards, and control wells. Add 10 µL of Assay Buffer to the background (0 pg/ml standard) and sample wells.
